caption: The drawing features a textured brown background with lines simulating a woven fabric. Over this background, there are various natural elements illustrated: two birds with brown and yellow bodies and long tails are perched on green leafy branches that are intertwined with pink and red flowers. The foliage consists of green leaves of different shapes and sizes, and the flowers are predominantly pink, red, and white with yellow centers. In two locations, there are yellow woven baskets holding assorted flowers and greens; one basket is positioned in the lower center, and part of another basket is seen on the far left. The composition is arranged so the intertwined branches connect the two birds and the baskets with the surrounding flowers and leaves, covering most of the central area and leaving a narrow margin of plain background around the edges.
title: Glazed Chintz
